name: ChatGPT
description: OpenAI's current ChatGPT desktop app for macOS (agentic Codex features). Shown as ChatGPT.app; Sparkle channel title remains Codex.

extraction.note: Channel title is Codex; enclosure files are ChatGPT-darwin-{arch}-{version}.zip. Intel feed: appcast-x64.xml.

download.note: Prefer Sparkle enclosure. Fallback pattern uses arm64/x64 via {ARCH}/{ARCH_ALT}.

changelog.url: included in sparkle:releaseNotesLink field of appcast item

notes: As of mid-2026 OpenAI's new desktop ChatGPT app uses bundle id com.openai.codex and installs as ChatGPT.app (CFBundleAlternateNames includes Codex). Distinct from ChatGPT Classic (com.openai.chat). User data under ~/.codex and ~/Library/Application Support/Codex.
